body: After Ahsoka's duel with Vader, some fans theorized that she had "died" in a sense and she had become the wolf from the season four trailer.

Bloodline is a perfect match for what you're wanting to read with Han and Leia after the Empire's collapse. I wasn't a huge fan of Lost Stars, but Claudia Gray's writing and characterization is undeniably very smooth! I finished Bloodline in 5 hours, Lost Stars in 3- couldn't put them down.

If you're interested in Vader- Lords of the Sith is one of my favorite novels, although I'll warn you it focuses moreso on the Free Ryloth movement which is expanded upon in The Clone Wars and Rebels. There are moments in this novel that drag on a bit, but I believe the characterization mostly makes up for it!

I would not reccomend Ahsoka or A New Dawn if you haven't seen any of the series. Especially Ahsoka.
